questions.question: When should you signal left before turning into a side road?
options: In good time, at least two seconds before turning
Only after your front wheels cross the line
Only when a car is right behind you
questions.explanation: Rule 182 says to give a clear left signal in good time.

questions.question: When turning right across oncoming traffic, what must you wait for?
options: A safe gap so oncoming cars do not slow down
The driver behind to sound their horn
questions.explanation: Rule 180 says wait until oncoming traffic is clear before turning right.

questions.question: Where should you position your car before turning left?
options: Close to the left kerb without swinging wide
questions.explanation: Rule 182 says keep well to the left before a left turn.
